name: BS 546 15 A / SANS 164-1 (Type M)
description: Large three-round-pin plug and socket of the British BS 546 family in its 15 A size: line and neutral pins 25.4 mm apart with a larger earth pin above them. The IEC letter M designates this configuration. South Africa standardises it as SANS 164-1 and rates it 16 A; SANS 164-2 (Type N) is its designated successor there.

standards.scope: British round-pin system in 2, 5, 15 and 30 A sizes; the 15 A size is IEC type M; not reviewed
South African 16 A, 250 V version of the BS 546 15 A configuration (first published as SABS 164 in 1994); not reviewed

relations.note: Both are sizes of BS 546; the 5 A size (Type D) is the smaller member of the same system.

variants.name: 15/16 A three-round-pin plug
variants.keying: The larger, longer earth pin above the line pins enforces one orientation.
mechanicalNotes: Line and neutral pins 7.0 mm in diameter, 21.1 mm long, 25.4 mm apart (SANS 164-1 figures).
Earth pin 8.7 mm in diameter, 29.0 mm long, 28.6 mm from the line and neutral pin centres (SANS 164-1 figures).

variants.name: 15/16 A three-round-pin socket-outlet
variants.keying: Large earth hole above the line and neutral holes.
mechanicalNotes: SANS 164-1 socket-outlets have mandatory shutters on the line and neutral holes, opened by the earth pin or by both line pins together.
